name: Inose Takahisa
source:
Junta’s scheming second in command. Takahisa dreams of overthrowing his superior and taking direct control of the gang, but lacks the bravery and charisma to successfully achieve it. He secretly lusts after [url=/c700]Ayame[/url], but cannot act upon these feels so long as [url=/c1542]Junta[/url] favors her. Frustrated by these denials, Takahisa merely sulks in the shadows waiting for his opportunity.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320235028/http://www.erogereview.com/2011/06/07/gokuin-no-sentou//]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
